B) shrink the D2 shift to <=1.15 mm: keeps the chain, but FAILS both acceptance bounds (pads 1.9 / body 1.5) - i.e. the owner's anti-edge goal is not met.
C) move D2 in a DIFFERENT direction (e.g. +X to the empty area) - not ordered; would need a new ruling.
D) accept a smaller, explicitly-stated margin: e.g. pads-to-edge >= 1.5 (Δ=1.15) - violates the stated 2.0.
NOTE: the ruling's 'SW_U2 leg translates with D2' already implies re-routing SW_U2 (its chain anchor (38.85,36.55) must follow D2.2); the physical BLOCKER is the chain body, not the leg.
